cues.en: and sports which are both strings but can also be of mixed types, like personal data where we might have
cues.zh: 和 sports，兩者都是字串，但也可以是混合類型，例如個人資料，我們可能有

cues.en: Now I'll comment this out and let's move on to the next part about arrays,

cues.en: the end of the array,

cues.zh: 它們只是在陣列裡加一個元素或移除它。所以 push 和 pop 比 unshift 和
